system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 8. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (30 seconds, code score 0.63) ---
[b00] JULIANA (teasing, determined): "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
[b01] ALEXANDER (low, amused): "We'll see."
[b02] ALEXANDER (instructional, calm): "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."
[b03] JULIANA (soft, nostalgic): "My mother wrote the same thing."
[b04] JULIANA (hesitant, compassionate): "And the scars... were they from the war?"
[b05] ALEXANDER (quiet, subdued): "Some were."
[b06] JULIANA (tender, aching): "It must have been terrible."
[b07] ALEXANDER (heavy, somber): "It was."
[b08] JULIANA (reflective, vulnerable): "I thought losing wealth meant losing everything."
[b09] JULIANA (quiet, transformed): "Perhaps I was wrong."
[b10] ACTION: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

--- WINDOW 1 (34 seconds, code score 0.56) ---
[b00] JULIANA (inquiring, soft): "How do you know that?"
[b01] ALEXANDER (somber, matter-of-fact): "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
[b02] JULIANA (observant, lightly teasing): "You know more about healing than you let on."
[b03] ALEXANDER (quiet, gritty): "Enough to survive."
[b04] JULIANA (hesitant, soft): "Your hair and beard..."
[b05] JULIANA (gentle, tender): "I could trim them for you."
[b06] ALEXANDER (firm, low): "Not yet."
[b07] JULIANA (puzzled, curious): "Not yet?"
[b08] ALEXANDER (grounded, steady): "Let them grow."
[b09] JULIANA (playful, amused): "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[b10] ALEXANDER (dry, droll): "It has advantages."
[b11] JULIANA (fond, resigned): "Very well."
[b12] JULIANA (teasing, determined): "But one day, I am trimming that beard."

--- WINDOW 2 (22 seconds, code score 0.49) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.
[b01] JULIANA (gentle, somber): "Some of the pages are ruined. Careful."
[b02] SFX: Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
[b03] JULIANA (reflective, reverent): "Mother spent years writing this."
[b04] ACTION: Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
[b05] JULIANA (curious, recognizing): "Yarrow."
[b06] ALEXANDER (calm, knowledgeable): "Good for wounds. Fever, too."
[b07] JULIANA (inquiring, soft): "How do you know that?"
[b08] ALEXANDER (somber, matter-of-fact): "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
[b09] JULIANA (observant, lightly teasing): "You know more about healing than you let on."

Pick the single best promo.
